top_comments.author: centminmod
top_comments.body: Yup hit this one too on 1.0.59!

top_comments.author: haryoiro
top_comments.body:
I had the same issue and resolved it by unsetting the CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS.

```sh
unset CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
```
